name: Miami County, OH
findings: Miami County has 399 nonprofit organizations. 175 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 129 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Miami County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Miami County list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 80 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 25 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 2 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Miami County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
